_note: Single source of truth for affiliate partners. NEVER fill trackingTemplate until the program has approved the account. 'verified: true' only when the figure was read on the vendor's or network's own page on checkedAt. Third-party figures stay 'verified: false'.

partners.name: Dinero

commission.text: 50 kr. per referred user who signs up within 30 days, paid or free plan; leads must be confirmed by the user

partners.notes: Danish accounting software with its own affiliate page. Payout schedule/threshold not stated on the page; check in Partner-ads.

partners.name: Pipedrive

commission.text: 20% revenue share for the first 12 months of a new paying customer (entry tier); 30% at 2-5 sales/month for 6 months

restrictions: Offline promotion needs prior written approval
partners.notes: Payouts via PartnerStack; commissions locked on the 7th two months after the transaction, paid on the 13th.

partners.name: monday.com

commission.text: Sources conflict: 'up to 20% on each closed deal' plus CPL (PartnerStack blog) vs '20% recurring' (Supademo list)

partners.notes: Check monday.com's own partner page before applying.

partners.name: Canva

commission.text: Reported ~$36 per annual Pro referral or 80% of first two months (third-party, Make Influence; Canva's own page not read)

partners.notes: Reportedly requires acceptance into the Canvassador programme first.

partners.name: Notion
